ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Inborn uses the microphone to dictate and to talk with the assistant. Audio is processed on this device and never leaves it.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Inborn turns your speech into text with the on-device recognizer only. Nothing is sent to Apple or anyone else.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Inborn uses the camera to take a photo for the assistant to look at. The photo stays on this device.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Inborn lets you pick a photo for the assistant to look at. Photos are scaled down on this device and never uploaded.
